learning_objective: 🎯 Get inspired by Dr. Deepa Malik, a Paralympic athlete who proved that physical disabilities and societal barriers cannot stop a determined spirit!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: लचीलापन (मुसीबत से वापस उठने की क्षमता)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: This chapter is an inspiring interview with Dr. Deepa Malik. She made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win a medal in the Paralympic Games, achieving global acclaim.
She faced severe physical challenges. Spinal tumors left her paralyzed below the chest. However, instead of giving up, she fought back with incredible resilience and a positive attitude towards life.
Dr. Malik used sports to regain her dignity, fitness, and independence. Her success helped break societal stereotypes and showed the world that disabled people are equally capable.
Her journey teaches us a powerful lesson: our possibilities are only limited by our own minds. With self-belief, dignity, and hard work, one can overcome any physical or social barrier.

fun_activity.title: 🏅 Research a Hero
fun_activity.instructions: Find out which specific sport Dr. Deepa Malik won her historic Paralympic medal in (Hint: It involves throwing a heavy metal ball as far as possible!). Share her achievement with your friends.

exam_tips: 📌 Highlight the central theme of 'resilience and dignity' in Dr. Deepa Malik's life and how she turned her tragedy into a triumph.
📌 Be ready to answer how sports act as a tool for empowerment and change society's perspective on physical disabilities.
📌 Remember that the chapter is formatted as an 'interview', which gives a direct insight into her thoughts and struggles.
quick_recap: ⭐ Dr. Deepa Malik is a living example of 'ability beyond disability'.
⭐ Her story teaches that personal adversity can be a stepping stone to global success if faced with courage.
⭐ She is a strong advocate for disability rights and creating an inclusive society.
